projectMeta.name: RAG
projectMeta.domain: Document Q&A; retrieval-augmented generation over custom knowledge bases
projectMeta.purpose: Index documents (PDF or web), store in vector stores (Pinecone or FAISS), and answer user questions via retrieval and optional LLM generation
techStack: LangChain (community, text_splitters, google_genai, openai, pinecone, core, chat_models)

problemStatement.context: Need to query specific documents (PDFs, web pages, or markdown) with natural language and get answers grounded in that content.

userFlow.description: User provides or system loads documents (PDF path, URL, or markdown)
Documents are split into chunks and embedded (Google Gemini)
Vectors are stored in Pinecone or FAISS
User asks a question (CLI input or notebook invoke)
System retrieves top-k similar chunks (similarity search)
In 007_rag.ipynb only: context + question are sent to LLM (gpt-4.1-nano); answer returned. In rag_doc.py: top snippets printed only.

backend: rag.ipynb: Jupyter cells for markdown → Pinecone indexing and similarity search
007_rag.ipynb: Jupyter cells for web/PDF load, split, FAISS, LangGraph RAG (retrieve → generator)
databases: FAISS local vector store (in-memory or load_local)

dataFlow.data: File path or URL, optional BS4 strainer

dataFlow.trigger: User input in CLI or graph.invoke

dataFlow.data: State with question and context (doc list)

coreFeatures.name: PDF load and chunk
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Loads a PDF and splits it into text chunks with overlap

coreFeatures.name: Web page load
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Fetches and parses a URL into document chunks
coreFeatures.implementationSummary: WebBaseLoader with bs4 SoupStrainer (post-title, post-header, post-content)

coreFeatures.name: Markdown header split
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Splits markdown by headers (#, ##, ###) with metadata

coreFeatures.name: Google Gemini embeddings
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Produces 768-dim embeddings for chunks and queries

coreFeatures.name: Pinecone index and upsert
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Creates or reuses Pinecone index and stores vectors
coreFeatures.implementationSummary: Pinecone client, create_index (768 dim, cosine, ServerlessSpec), PineconeVectorStore.from_documents or add_documents

coreFeatures.name: FAISS vector store
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Local vector index for similarity search; save/load to disk
coreFeatures.implementationSummary: FAISS from langchain_community.vectorstores, save_local/load_local with allow_dangerous_deserialization

coreFeatures.name: Similarity search
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Returns top-k document chunks for a query

coreFeatures.name: RAG agent (retrieve + generate)
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Retrieves context then generates answer with LLM
coreFeatures.implementationSummary: StateGraph(State) with nodes retrieve and generator; retrieve does similarity_search k=4; generator builds prompt (context + question), invokes init_chat_model('gpt-4.1-nano', 'openai'), returns answer

coreFeatures.name: CLI Q&A loop
coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Interactive terminal: user types question, system prints top snippets (no LLM answer)
coreFeatures.implementationSummary: while True input loop, similarity_search_with_score(user_query, k=3), print score/page/content; exit on exit/quit/q

performanceOptimizations: Chunk size and overlap tuned for context (1000/150 or 1000/200)
Top-k limited (3 or 4) to bound context size
securityConsiderations: No input validation or sanitization on user questions
No auth for CLI or notebook; no rate limiting
errorHandling: Index existence check before Pinecone create (rag_doc.py)
No try/except or explicit error handling in analyzed code

uiPatternsObserved: CLI: prompt 'User: ', print snippets with score and page, 250-char content preview
Notebook: cell-by-cell execution, output of documents and search results in notebook
interactionLogic: rag_doc.py: sequential loop (question → print snippets → repeat)
007_rag.ipynb: graph.invoke({'question': '...'}) returns final state with answer

limitations: No web UI; Gradio in requirements but not used in analyzed code
LLM-based answer generation only in 007_rag.ipynb; rag_doc.py and rag.ipynb retrieval-only
No explicit error handling for missing file, API failure, or empty results
